# openobserve_organizations (Data Source)

Lists the OpenObserve organizations the configured credentials can see.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_organizations" "all" {}

output "organization_ids" {
  value = [for o in data.openobserve_organizations.all.organizations : o.identifier]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID.
- `organizations` (Attributes List) The organizations found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))

<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Read-Only:

- `identifier` (String) Organization identifier.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `org_type` (String) Organization type.
- `user_email` (String) Email of the organization owner.
